label: Ordinary dividends
description: Form 1040 (2025), line 3b: total ordinary dividends. Composes from Form 1099-DIV box 1a over the closed tax.us.2025.f1099div.1a family, gated on that family's closure only (ADR-0035 decisions 1-2, per-box closure independence).

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes this ordinary-dividend amount; its lineage pins the box-1a subtotal.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero from present box-1a findings that sum to zero. The box-1a family is closed.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero because the box-1a family is attested closed on its current horizon with no recorded members.

blocked.explain: Ordinary dividends is blocked because the box-1a family is unclosed or its dependencies are missing.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value exists because the rule guard is false.
